scenario_description: A mixed healthcare environment with several strong safeguards enabled but multiple Week 10 gaps still present for testing and remediation review.

evidence_inventory.encryption_at_rest: Database encryption configuration approved on ehr-sql-prod; evidence file: encryption_config_review_2026-07.pdf
evidence_inventory.encrypted_backups: Backup policy and encrypted storage screenshot; evidence file: encrypted_backup_console.png
evidence_inventory.firewall_protection: Firewall review ticket and approved ruleset; evidence file: fw_rule_review_July2026.pdf
evidence_inventory.antivirus_endpoint_protection: Endpoint console coverage export; evidence file: endpoint_health_report.csv
evidence_inventory.rbac_enabled: Access matrix with quarterly review evidence; evidence file: rbac_review_Q2_2026.xlsx
evidence_inventory.workstation_security: Workstation policy draft exists but device enforcement evidence is incomplete.
evidence_inventory.secure_remote_access: Remote access policy with MFA enforcement screenshot; evidence file: remote_access_mfa.png
evidence_inventory.audit_logging: SIEM log collection enabled; evidence file: siem_collection_status.png
evidence_inventory.risk_assessment_completed: Formal risk assessment signed this quarter; evidence file: risk_assessment_2026_Q2.pdf
evidence_inventory.contingency_disaster_recovery_planning: Documented contingency and DR program; evidence file: contingency_dr_program.pdf
evidence_inventory.incident_response_plan: Missing current approved incident response plan.
evidence_inventory.assigned_security_privacy_contact: Security officer listed in policy index and staff directory.
evidence_inventory.breach_reporting_process: Breach reporting workflow documented in privacy handbook.
evidence_inventory.suspicious_activity_reporting_process: No clear workforce reporting workflow posted in current materials.
evidence_inventory.alert_review_procedures: SOC triage process documented and approved.
evidence_inventory.post_incident_documentation: Recent incidents lack completed closeout records.
evidence_inventory.staff_retraining_after_incidents: No retraining evidence attached after recent simulated incidents.
evidence_inventory.backup_testing: Backups exist but last documented restore validation is overdue.
evidence_inventory.disaster_recovery_plan: DR plan v2 approved by IT governance.
evidence_inventory.downtime_procedures: Downtime procedure draft is incomplete and not approved.
evidence_inventory.critical_system_identification: Critical services inventory includes EHR, auth, VPN, logging, and backup systems.
evidence_inventory.recovery_evidence_documented: Recovery evidence repository missing recent restore records.
evidence_inventory.tamper_evident_logging: Log immutability or equivalent protection is not enabled.
evidence_inventory.unauthorized_modification_detection: File integrity or unauthorized modification detection is not enabled.
evidence_inventory.backup_integrity_checks: Backup checksum verification enabled on backup jobs.
evidence_inventory.restoration_testing: No recent documented restoration test evidence available.
